sections.label: Challenges
sections.title: Your people use AI every day, but the company can't measure the impact
sections.intro: Everyone uses a different tool. Costs add up person by person, and no one can roll up the results.

pains.title: No common standard
pains.text: Each person has their own tool and habits. There's no shared rule on what to hand to AI.

pains.title: Data leaks, legal risk
pains.text: Customer data gets pasted into outside services. Under Vietnam's 2025 Personal Data Protection Law, the company is accountable for that data.

pains.title: Unmeasured spend
pains.text: Subscriptions and AI usage fees pile up per person, and nobody knows what they deliver.

rows.now: Data is split across systems and no one has the full picture.
rows.new: AI reads from one agreed data source, connected directly to your company systems.

rows.quote: “Our best people spend all day in Excel.”
rows.now: Repetitive work eats up your experts' time.
rows.new: Repetitive tasks become reusable skills, and your best people get back to judgment calls.

rows.quote: “When they leave, the whole process leaves with them.”
rows.now: Know-how lives in a few people's heads and is hard to hand over.
rows.new: Documents and instructions live in shared projects, so everyone follows the same standard.

items.q: Does our data leave the company?
items.a: It doesn't have to. For high-security environments, Pythera deploys privately on your own infrastructure. Admins see usage statistics but cannot read employees' conversations.

items.q: How soon will we see results?
items.a: We start with an assessment and a trial on sample data, then pilot in one department and measure results before rolling out company-wide.
Delivery fees are based on the time Pythera's team spends with you. AI usage can be paid as a package through Pythera or directly to the provider you choose.
Acceptance is based on five conditions agreed up front, including an AI quality threshold. If they aren't met, the work isn't accepted.

items.q: Do our staff need to code?
items.a: No. Staff simply describe the task in plain language, like asking a colleague.

sections.title: Start with one small workflow
sections.text: In the first assessment, Pythera works with you to pick one workflow, review the data and run a trial on sample data. Only then do we agree scope and acceptance criteria in writing.

assurances.title: No hidden extras
assurances.text: Scope is written into the contract. Anything outside it needs your written approval.

assurances.title: A clear finish line
assurances.text: Acceptance follows five conditions agreed on day one.

assurances.title: Your data stays under control
assurances.text: Role-based permissions, spending limits and full logs.
